title: 失业率降了：但原因，让人意外
speaker: Anna Wong

segments.en: The difference between the falling unemployment rate on one hand and a very weak payroll on the other hand in a July sprint was mainly because in the household survey, it shows that the labor force participation continued to fall driven by people between age 16 to 24.
segments.zh: 7月失业率下降与就业数据疲软的分化，主要源于家庭调查显示，16至24岁人群的劳动参与率持续下降。

segments.en: And those folks are dropping out of the labor market. And because you have a shrinking labor pool, you don't just don't need a lot of increase in hiring to cause an unemployment rate to go down.
segments.zh: 这些人正在退出劳动力市场。由于劳动力池缩小，不需要大量新增就业，失业率就会下降。

segments.en: So it is a fall in unemployment rate that's due to the wrong reasons.
segments.zh: 所以，失业率下降的原因并不健康。

segments.en: Well, the unemployment went down because people gave up and stopped looking for work. It also seems an interesting indication that it's in those ages that you talked about.
segments.zh: 失业率下降是因为人们放弃找工作。有趣的是，这主要集中在您提到的年龄段。

segments.en: So it's younger people who are deciding not to be applying for these jobs. What are they doing? Are they waiting to enter the workforce?
segments.zh: 年轻人决定不申请这些工作。他们在做什么？是在等待进入职场吗？

segments.en: I think it could be a more harmless explanation. It could be that it is July after all, and people, especially the younger folks, folks who are waiting to go to college, the college students themselves, they are just off vacationing.
segments.zh: 我认为这可能是更无害的解释。毕竟现在是7月，尤其是年轻人、等待上大学的学生，他们正在度假。

segments.en: and they are just not working in their usual summer job and not looking for a summer job in the thick of July.
segments.zh: 他们没有做通常的暑期工作，也没有在7月中旬寻找暑期工作。
